title: Why Editing and Proofreading Matter Before Submission
primary_keyword: editing and proofreading before manuscript submission
key_findings: New static blog article added through PeekBooks' existing Next.js blog system.
Self-referencing canonical, Open Graph URL, Twitter metadata, BlogPosting schema, FAQPage schema, and breadcrumb schema are generated by existing helpers.
Article is included automatically in sitemap.xml through BLOG_POSTS.
Local WebP hero image added with descriptive alt text.
Internal links point only to existing public service, pricing, submit, and blog routes.
limitations: No Google Search Console or production crawl data was available in this session.
